quote: If a highway has been designed to provide a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions, the following rules apply: A vehicle must not travel more than 50 feet in a center turn lane after making a left-hand turn onto the highway before merging with traffic.

activation.description: A highway has one center lane designed only for turns by both directions.
activation.source_clause: a single center lane to be used only for turning by traffic moving in both directions

obligation.description: Do not travel more than 200 feet in that lane after the left turn onto the highway before merging with traffic.
obligation.source_clause: must not travel more than 50 feet in a center turn lane after making a left-hand turn onto the highway before merging with traffic

timing.description: Measure from observed left-turn completion to first full-body through-lane merge contact.
timing.source_clause: must not travel more than 50 feet in a center turn lane after making a left-hand turn onto the highway before merging with traffic
